method.reconciliation: Each maintained map row was compared with live repository metadata and its current default-branch commit/tree; all 14 map entries resolved to the same repository name and were readable.
method.source_scope: Content inventory is pinned to each observed default-branch commit. Tree snapshots were complete and untruncated. No all-branch absence claim is made.
method.issues_and_pull_requests: All-state issue and PR endpoints were paginated with per_page=100; issue endpoint pull-request records were excluded; snapshots include current open and closed records as returned at observation time.
method.content_vs_control: Artifact content status and repository settings/control status are separate. A source file does not prove a setting is configured or a workflow executed.
method.ownership: Repository-map owner roles are proposed planning roles. No named owner, assignee, reviewer, security contact or adoption confirmation is inferred.
method.evidence_bundle: Read-only snapshots are outside the tracked repository at the supervisor run’s gh01-evidence/ directory; each record also provides GitHub source URLs and snapshot paths.
method.existing_work_reconciliation: 21 scoped issue/PR body findings from the independent review were joined to the saved all-state snapshots by repository, number, canonical URL, state, merged_at and body digest. No body text is copied. Each issue/PR is mapped to artifact categories that its body scope affects; central issue keys are retained separately for tracing to the planned leaf backlog. Candidate and merged records do not prove adoption or completion.
method.supplemental_content_review: A content-level scan inspected all 126 maintained Markdown files in the complete frozen default-branch trees. The follow-up capture consists of 54 previously unselected Markdown files, each pinned to the original tree SHA and carrying its own retrieval time; these later reads do not revise the original API observation timestamp or issue/PR counts. The versioned getticketstub.com architecture kit contains partial exact-component pin, reproducible assembly, compatibility-check, release-record and workflow caller guidance; its repository brief 06 records planned .github ownership/adoption with delivery and checks still pending. The shared-contracts catalog provides partial schema-version compatibility guidance. team-dashboard has partial CI guidance in docs/integration/TD-11-ci.md and host-specific package pin/rollback/adoption instructions in docs/integration/mount-contract.md; these sources do not prove workflow execution or host adoption and do not constitute complete shared policy. The dated private-visibility statement in the architecture kit is preserved separately from current public metadata. The remaining reviewed decision, contract, handoff and security documents describe domain implementation/acceptance, and no additional reusable repository-governance policy was identified. The central work-package plan records planned tasks and dependencies, not completion or adoption. Detailed pinned source records and scan evidence are in additional-doc-review.json and full-markdown-review/ outside the tracked repository.

visibility_note: The source map is dated 2026-10-10 and records private visibility for 13 entries. Current live API metadata at the later snapshot time reports all 14 public.
